info.name: Dodo Invoices API
info.description:
End-to-end tests for every endpoint and case of the invoice & payment service.

**Run order matters.** Use the Collection Runner on the whole collection: later folders reuse ids saved by earlier ones (customerId, invoiceId, webhookSecret, ...).

Prerequisite: `docker compose up --build` in `dodo-invoices/`.

Variables:
- `baseUrl` / `pspUrl`: the API and mock PSP.
- `apiKey`: the demo business key from docker-compose.yml.
- `webhookSinkUrl`: where the API (not Postman) sends webhooks. `http://mock-psp:4000/webhook-sink` inside Docker; use `http://localhost:4000/webhook-sink` if you run the API with `cargo run`.
- `reconcileWaitMs`: how long folder 09 waits for the reconciler (default 100000).

Folder 09 takes about 2 minutes because the reconciler only touches invoices locked for 60+ s.
